`aots-report` exposes three subcommands. Run it through the project environment as `uv run aots-report`.

## `snapshot`

```text
aots-report snapshot --baseline PATH --out PATH
```

| Option | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `--baseline PATH` | yes | none | Known-Good Baseline directory to validate and materialize. |
| `--out PATH` | yes | none | Snapshot Output Bundle directory. |

The command returns exit code `2` when baseline validation fails.

## `export-snowflake`

```text
aots-report export-snowflake --country CODE --storm ID --forecast-time TIME (--out PATH | --case-name NAME) [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `--country CODE` | yes | none | Country code used by the export queries. |
| `--storm ID` | yes | none | Storm/track identifier used by the export queries. |
| `--forecast-time TIME` | yes | none | Forecast time used by the export queries. |
| `--out PATH` | runtime choice | none | Explicit baseline output directory. |
| `--case-name NAME` | runtime choice | none | Writes under `known-good-baselines/NAME` when `--out` is omitted. |
| `--env-file PATH` | no | none | dotenv file supplying `SNOWFLAKE_*` settings. Shell environment values take precedence. |
| `--wind-threshold INTEGER` | no, repeatable | `[]` | Explicit wind threshold. In a live export, an empty list triggers threshold discovery; plan construction falls back to `34` when no threshold has been supplied. |
| `--zoom-level INTEGER` | no | `14` | Zoom level for tile artifacts. |
| `--admin-level INTEGER` | no | `1` | Administrative level for admin artifacts. |
| `--include-alert-html` | no | `false` | Requests export of `ALERT_SENT_LOG.EMAIL_BODY` as `expected-alert.html` when a matching row exists. |
| `--overwrite` | no | `false` | Allows replacement of a non-empty output directory after a temporary export validates. |
| `--plan-only` | no | `false` | Validates configuration and prints the plan without connecting or writing. |
| `--dry-run` | no | `false` | Alias for `--plan-only`. |
| `--json` | no | `false` | Prints the secret-free export plan as JSON. |

`argparse` does not make `--out` or `--case-name` individually required. Runtime validation requires at least one. If both are supplied, `--out` wins. If neither is supplied, the command writes `either --out or --case-name is required` to stderr and returns `2`.

Credentials come from `SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT`, `SNOWFLAKE_USER`, `SNOWFLAKE_PASSWORD`, `SNOWFLAKE_WAREHOUSE`, `SNOWFLAKE_DATABASE`, `SNOWFLAKE_SCHEMA`, and optional `SNOWFLAKE_ROLE`; there is no password CLI option.

## `publish`

```text
aots-report publish --snapshots-dir PATH --out PATH
```

| Option | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `--snapshots-dir PATH` | yes | none | Directory whose child directories are Snapshot Output Bundles. |
| `--out PATH` | yes | none | Publication manifest, Quarto source, and rendered site output directory. |

`publish` consumes Snapshot Output Bundles, not Known-Good Baselines.

## Implementation Authority

The parser and runtime dispatch in `src/aots_portable_reports/cli.py` are authoritative. Export defaults are represented by `ExportRequest` in `src/aots_portable_reports/export_snowflake.py`.
